Hi Amir — thanks for the clear ask and the RFI. High level we recommend a three-path approach to reduce lead-time risk while keeping unit economics reasonable:

1) Cloud reserve (short-term ramp): reserve ~55–65% of needed concurrent capacity as committed cloud slots for 3–6 months to guarantee immediate availability for internal testing and soft launch. Calypso can provide regional reserved pools with 7–10 day activation.
2) OEM pre-order (mid term): pre-order ~25–35% of the fleet with split shipments in two tranches (ship1: baseline units for testing, ship2: remainder for traffic). Typical OEM ETA we see is 10–16 weeks from PO depending on SKU.
3) Safety stock (buffer): hold 5–15% in vendor-managed safety stock or Redwood-managed staging pool for the first 90 days to cover QoS incidents or customs delays.

I attached an onramp-sizing-worksheet.xlsx that maps our suggested split to your target of ~120 GPUs. I also included two scenarios (aggressive vs conservative). Quick bullets below: 

- Suggested baseline: 70 cloud reserved + 35 OEM preorders + 15 safety stock (total effective capacity ~120).
- If OEM quoted ETA slips >4 weeks, increase cloud reserve by an incremental tranche to keep launch date.
- Recommend a 30% deposit for OEM preorder with escrow and staged acceptance tied to QA and delivery milestones.

Next steps:
- Ben, can you draft a commercial term sheet (deposit, cancellation, price ladder) by Wed EOD?
- Karthik, can you engage Nova (OEM) and Calypso (cloud) to confirm express availability and split-shipment feasibility?
- Amir, if you can confirm acceptable split (e.g., 70/35/15) we will convert this into a formal offer + timeline.

I placed a draft worksheet on Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcOnrampPrep

Thanks for the details — we've reviewed the RFI and the sizing worksheet. Short summary of what Nova can offer for RDW-DEAL-1537: 

1) Split shipments: we can split the preorder into two shipments. Ship1 (25 units) earliest ETA: 12 Aug 2026; Ship2 (10 units) ETA: 02 Sep 2026. Shipments will depart factory in batches and consolidate at Port of Oakland for vendor staging.
2) Safety stock / staging: we offer vendor-managed staging for up to 90 days with a per-unit holding fee (TBD). Alternatively, Redwood can take physical custody at our bonded warehouse and we can bill storage to Orion.
3) Escrow / deposit: standard for these SKUs is 30% deposit; Nova accepts third-party escrow. We can accept staged release of 50% on ship1 acceptance and remainder at ship2 completion as requested.
4) Customs & shipping: typical transit + customs clearance to Bay Area is 4–6 weeks from factory ship date; plan 7–10 days on-dock QA. Add 10–14 days buffer for peak-season congestion.

We attached a short split-shipment proposal with preliminary pricing and staging fee bands. Two optional mitigations to shorten lead time if required: (a) swap for an equivalent SKU we have prioritized for Q3 (adds ~$200/unit and reduces ETA by ~3 weeks), or (b) allocate a partial pool from our allocation bucket (requires confirmation of deposit within 48 hours).

If you confirm the split (25 / 10) and authorize a 30% deposit, we will lock the factory slots and return an updated PO + ETA milestones within 24 hours.
